 You start the morning reviewing a PR from a teammate who's building a new budget threshold visualization — you leave feedback on the API contract and suggest a simpler state management approach on the frontend.  After lunch, you notice an alarm firing for elevated latency on one of your team's Cost Explorer APIs.  You end the day pushing code for a React component you've been building — a widget that makes multi\-account cost trends scannable at a glance. It's behind a feature flag, shipping incrementally.

**Description**
 AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end\-to\-end products that surprise and delight out\-of\-the\-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
   

  

 Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those workspaces will host AI agents alongside humans agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft Citrix and Omnissa and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era not retrofitted for it.
   

  

 Agentic WorkSpaces' Data Plane is the connective tissue that makes this possible: the single entry point through which every WorkSpaces connection flows and the streaming backbone that delivers the desktop experience once a session begins. We own the end\-to\-end pre\-session journey authentication across every identity method, session authorization, resource discovery, gateway selection, and cross\-region failover as well as the in\-session streaming stack that carries pixels to the user and the pipeline that delivers workspace health and performance metrics back to our customers.
   

  

 Our vision is for that connection to be seamless and invisible: users and the agents working beside them reach their workspace instantly and securely sessions stream with high fidelity and low latency failover is transparent and the health of every connection is observable through the same AWS tools customers already use delivered reliably from commercial regions to classified partitions at a scale where availability and security are non\-negotiable.
   

  

 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate the services that authenticate authorize connect and stream WorkSpaces sessions for humans and increasingly for the AI agents that work beside them across every supported identity provider and streaming protocol. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of features and systems within the Data Plane from design through deployment and operations holding a high bar for availability latency and security on the services that stand between every customer and their workspace.
   

  

 You are customer\-obsessed technically deep and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like a connection fabric that treats humans and agents as first\-class principals streaming that adapts intelligently to network conditions and brokering that routes and heals itself before users notice a problem and then you build the systems to get there.
   

  

 You thrive in ambiguity make sound trade\-off decisions with incomplete information and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in distributed systems identity real\-time streaming and network infrastructure at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver features and systems within the Data Plane contributing to the architecture strategy for how the connection and streaming layer evolves to broker and stream sessions for AI agents alongside human users.
* Drive the work that unifies and simplifies how sessions are brokered and streamed across protocols making a consistent high\-fidelity connection experience the default. Partner with compute identity providers networking and gateway teams earning trust by driving technical discussions that result in impactful architectural decisions.
* Design and implement pre\-session authentication authorization and governance for a world where humans and agents share the same connection path: identity integration across every authentication method session authorization and access policies that treat agents as first\-class principals and a security posture built in rather than bolted on.
* Own the operation of low\-latency high\-availability brokering and streaming services that are the single entry point for more than one million WorkSpaces users globally. Ensure your services meet stringent SLAs across multiple production regions AWS partitions and streaming protocols with self\-healing routing transparent cross\-region failover and autonomous issue resolution before customers are impacted.
* Drive engineering excellence through instrumentation automated testing and pipeline\-based deployment eliminating manual toil and delivering a consistent connection and streaming experience across every protocol. Think big about the agentic era and experiment boldly with AI\-powered capabilities such as intelligent gateway selection self\-diagnosing connections and AI\-assisted operational management.
